description: Defines the CalendarRepository interface with methods for managing calendar events, leaves, and astrology details.

classes.name: CalendarRepository
classes.description: An interface that provides suspend functions for managing calendar events, leaves, and astrology details.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CalendarEvent objects within a specified time range.

methods.name: getEventsForDate
methods.description: Retrieves events for a specific date.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event by its ID.

methods.name: getEventsModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves events modified after a specific timestamp.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Leave objects.

methods.name: getLeavesForPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves leaves within a specific time period.

methods.name: deleteLeave
methods.description: Deletes a leave entry by its ID.

methods.name: getLeavesModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves leaves modified after a specific timestamp.

methods.name: getAstrologyDetails
methods.description: Retrieves astrology details for a specific date.

methods.name: getAstrologyModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves astrology details modified after a specific timestamp.
